relationship: Executable materialization of already-preregistered G13R; no change to G13 or G13L.
architecture: exact G8C causal_hybrid DADA model source semantics, 469648 trainable parameters, byte259 tokenizer
optimizer: AdamW lr=0.001, warmup=100, cosine to 15% at step400, betas=(0.9,0.95), weight_decay=0.01, clip=1
data_family_mix: round-robin arithmetic, conditional, code_trace, list_reasoning, memory_update within every difficulty stage
canonicalization: commutative +/* permutations grouped; subtraction ordered; list multiset+operation grouped; memory per-key value chronology plus queried key
render: same render for ordered and shuffled arms; completion boundary prompt -> F=<integer> -> EOS
evaluation: greedy free generation; strict parser fullmatch F=(-?\d+); generation function receives prompts only; gold joined after generation
checkpoint: final model.safetensors plus resume.pt containing model, AdamW, Python RNG, torch RNG and update logs; SHA256 and reload/next-update replay
note: G13R preregistration did not specify the optimizer recipe or exact text renderer; these implementation choices are frozen before data generation/training and are therefore not post-result tuning.
